title: Optimal Search with Accidentally Collapsing Measurements
description: Draft research manuscript. For unique-item search with a noiseless oracle and a Born sampler that independently projects its sampled register with probability epsilon, with outcomes and flags deferred until the circuit ends, the optimal total query/readout/preparation/ordinary-measurement cost is Theta(N^(1/3)+sqrt(epsilon N)). A fixed-power conditional-history fidelity argument gives the matching lower bound despite arbitrary entangled workspace and partial measurements. The ideal endpoint, conditional-copy framework and repeated-sampling template are attributed to prior work, including ABFL, Miloschewsky--Podder and prior imperfect-readout robustness by Abbas et al. This is a specified hypothetical postquantum model, not physical noisy hardware, a classification of all noisy PDQP or an ordinary BPP/BQP result. OpenAI Codex assisted derivation, literature comparison, drafting and internal checking. No independent human review, separate external-model review or formal certification has occurred.
